I replied to Dana in our DM to confirm I've noted that Dock 15 is now the dock for their Tamsin Cold Chain pickups, and that it stays between us.

The note lives only in that DM thread. I deliberately didn't save it to GBrain, because GBrain is shared and other people can read it, so saving it there would break Dana's request to keep it private. I checked GBrain first and found nothing that conflicts with the new dock. That search ran in a degraded keyword-only mode, so it may not have caught everything. I took no other action, since Dana said none was needed.
